sections.title: Computer Vision Applications for San Francisco Organizations
sections.description: Production-grade CV solutions for SF's leading industries.

blocks.heading: Autonomous Vehicle Perception Components
paragraphs: For Waymo (Mountain View, adjacent SF), Cruise (SF, GM subsidiary), Zoox (Foster City), and the AV technology ecosystem:

3D object detection from LiDAR and camera fusion: Multi-modal perception combining 64-channel LiDAR point clouds with RGB camera images — detecting, classifying, and tracking vehicles, pedestrians, cyclists, and edge cases (construction workers, delivery robots, unusual vehicles) at AV decision speed.

Semantic segmentation for AV scene understanding: Pixel-level scene classification for SF's complex urban driving environment — distinguishing drivable road surface from bike lanes, crosswalks, loading zones, and the uniquely SF challenge of hills, streetcar tracks, and dense pedestrian areas.

Edge case dataset curation: CV for identifying and curating long-tail edge cases from AV fleet data logs — the rare and unusual scenarios that frequent exposure doesn't provide sufficient training examples for.
Note: ClickMasters builds CV components and tools for AV development teams; full AV system integration requires the larger engineering organizations the major AV companies maintain internally.
Cost: $65,000–$185,000 | Timeline: 14–28 weeks | Production ML ops required

blocks.heading: Biotech Research Imaging AI
paragraphs: For Genentech (South San Francisco HQ), Gilead Sciences (Foster City), and the South San Francisco biotech cluster:

High-content screening CV: Automated cell imaging analysis for drug discovery HCS workflows — phenotypic profiling, cell viability measurement, organelle morphology classification, and compound effect quantification from fluorescent microscopy images.

Histopathology slide analysis: Digital pathology AI for Bay Area biotech's oncology drug development programs — tumor microenvironment characterization, immune cell infiltration quantification, and biomarker scoring from H&E and IHC-stained tissue sections.

Flow cytometry analysis: Automated gating and population identification from flow cytometry multi-parameter data for immunology research programs at Genentech, Gilead, and the Bay Area's large immune oncology research community.
Cost: $65,000–$180,000 | Timeline: 14–26 weeks | Research validation, proprietary data

blocks.heading: Retail and Commerce Analytics
paragraphs: For Safeway (Pleasanton CA, Bay Area's largest grocery chain), Trader Joe's (Monrovia, large Bay Area footprint), and SF's large specialty retail community:

In-store shopper analytics: Anonymous people counting, dwell time heatmaps, and queue length monitoring for SF's large grocery and specialty retail stores — enabling store layout optimization and staffing decisions based on shopper behavior.

Product recognition and shelf analytics: CV identifying products from shelf photography for out-of-stock detection, planogram compliance, and promotional display verification across the Bay Area's dense retail network.

Self-checkout fraud detection: CV for self-checkout stations — detecting scan avoidance, weight discrepancy, and item substitution for SF Bay Area retailers operating in one of the US's highest-shrink retail markets.
Cost: $55,000–$145,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | CCPA privacy-preserving design

blocks.heading: Earth Observation and Satellite Imagery
paragraphs: For Planet Labs (SF HQ), Maxar Technologies (Westminster CO, large SF operations), and the commercial earth observation community:
Agricultural monitoring: CV for crop health monitoring, yield estimation, and agricultural anomaly detection from Planet Labs' daily global satellite imagery.
Infrastructure change detection: CV identifying construction, deforestation, and infrastructure change from multi-temporal satellite image stacks for commercial earth observation applications.
Wildfire monitoring: Real-time wildfire detection and progression tracking from satellite and aerial imagery — directly applicable to California's devastating wildfire challenges.
Cost: $65,000–$165,000 | Timeline: 14–24 weeks

sections.title: San Francisco CV Technical Context
sections.description: Key considerations for CV development in San Francisco.

blocks.heading: AV perception quality standards
paragraphs: Bay Area AV companies have established the world's highest performance standards for object detection and tracking — ClickMasters AV CV components are benchmarked on nuScenes, KITTI, and Waymo Open Dataset standards that the AV industry recognizes.

blocks.heading: CCPA for retail CV
paragraphs: San Francisco's retail computer vision must avoid facial recognition and minimize biometric data collection under CCPA's sensitive personal information restrictions — ClickMasters designs SF retail CV as anonymous aggregate analytics.

blocks.heading: Research reproducibility
paragraphs: South San Francisco biotech's cell imaging AI must meet research reproducibility standards — ClickMasters delivers Docker containers, model versioning, and inference pipeline documentation meeting Nature Methods and Cell standards for computational methods reporting.
